messages:
mina (pm): quick idea — add an opt-in version heartbeat from SDKs so Console shows per-tenant SDK freshness.
rajarshi (eng): agree in principle. push vs inference? ping seems clearer.
sarah (platform): UX: a freshness column (green/yellow/red) and a docs hover. non-alarming language.
luis (eng-sre): ops: heartbeats must be non-billable, idempotent, and rate-limited (1/min/token).
mina (pm): plan: control-plane POST, non-billable, sample free-tier at 1%.
rajarshi (eng): client header proposal: x-rw-version-heartbeat: sdk-python/1.4.0
rajarshi (eng): snippet:
```
POST /v1/heartbeat
Authorization: Bearer <key>
x-rw-version-heartbeat: sdk-py/1.4.0
{}
```
luis (eng-sre): infra: write to hot-timeseries with 90d TTL; expose single query for console.
sarah (platform): console action: filter >30d drift + one-click message tenant (admin only).
mina (pm): legal check — no PII in ping. I'll confirm. timeline: prototype this sprint, SDK opt-in next minor.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: heartbeat-api -> staging 2025-05-02T14:00Z
mina (pm): assigning RFC to @rajarshi, mockups to @sarah. closing loop.
